_comment: Template schema for the travel map. One entry per visited country. Copy this file to countries.json once real data is added, delete this _comment field, and remove this example entry. 'iso' should be the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (used by most map libraries, e.g. react-simple-maps' TopoJSON) so the map component can match it to the right country shape.
